shortDescription: Brocade Fibre Channel time clock server configuration

options.name: clock_server
options.description: Clock server data structure containing ntp servers. WARNING - If ntp servers are not reachable, the operation may result in time out and playbook returning failure. All writable attributes supported by BSN REST API with - replaced with _.

options.name: throttle
options.description: Throttling delay in seconds. Enables second retry on first failure.

options.name: timeout
options.description: REST timeout in seconds for operations that take longer than FOS default value.

options.name: vfid
options.description: VFID of the switch. Use -1 for FOS without VF enabled or AG.
